# Florentine Kitchen Knives

> > Barcelona-based artisan knife maker offering handcrafted kitchen knives, bespoke customization, and immersive workshops for chefs and home cooks.

Florentine Kitchen Knives is a Barcelona-based manufacturer of premium handmade kitchen knives founded by Tomer Botner and Noam Blumenthal. The company combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design, offering curated collections, custom-made knives, and experiential workshops including knife-making and sharpening classes.

## Workshops & Experiences

- [Workshops](https://florentinekitchenknives.com/pages/workshops): Hands-on knife-making and sharpening workshops with expert instructors
- [1:1 Workshops](https://florentinekitchenknives.com/pages/1-1-workshops): Private one-on-one knife crafting and sharpening lessons in Barcelona
- [Corporate Workshops](https://florentinekitchenknives.com/pages/business-workshops): Team-building corporate workshops with Japanese sharpening techniques
- [Factory Dinners](https://florentinekitchenknives.com/collections/factory-dinners): Special event experiences and chef collaborations with dining experiences
